## Description
 Produce Strontium Hexaferrite. For every kilogram of ferrite produced, you need ~0.86 kg of &#10;&#9;&#9;Fe₂O₃ (hematite) and ~0.18 kg of BaCO₃ (or ~0.13 kg of SrCO₃). &#10;&#9;&#9;The hematite is trivially available; the carbonate is the limiting input.&#10;&#9;&#9;
